name: pwelch
expr: [p, f] = pwelch(x); r1 = double(sum(p)); [pe, fe] = pwelch(y, [], [], 128); ne = double(numel(pe));
comment: Sig: spectral DSP estimator. Default fs=2*pi (MATLAB convention) and 8-segment 50%-overlap Hamming window. pwelch(x,[],[],nfft): empty [] placeholders select defaults for window/noverlap (previously errored 'Cannot convert double to scalar'). pwelch(cos(2pi*.1*(0:127)),[],[],128) -> 65 bins, max=1.59267. Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b.
